simple.meaning: בּוּץ (bûwts) is a Hebrew object word meaning “probably cotton (of some sort).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 1 Chronicles 4:21. The surrounding context includes family, family line, altar, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בּוּץ (H948) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: בּוּץ (bûwts) / H948 is traced through 1 Chronicles 4:21, 1 Chronicles 15:27, 2 Chronicles 2:13, 2 Chronicles 3:14 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;
David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.
Now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, of Huram my father’s,
He made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.

also the Levites who were the singers, all of them, even Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers, arrayed in fine linen, with cymbals and stringed instruments and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them one hundred twenty priests sounding with trumpets);

There were hangings of white and blue material, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and marble pillars. The couches were of gold and silver, on a pavement of red, white, yellow, and black marble.
Mordecai went out of the presence of the king in royal clothing of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a robe of fine linen and purple; and the city of Susa shouted and was glad.
“ ‘ “Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of your handiworks. They traded for your wares with emeralds, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies.

definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (of the same form) meaning to bleach, i.e. (intransitive) be white;
